get.description:
Diff the live project against a snapshot (latest when snapshot_id omitted).

Pass ``pi_id`` to scope the diff to a single PI (including items moved into or
out of it). Returns per-entity added/removed/changed lists, a summary with an
effort delta, and a natural-language narrative.
Self-contained HTML rendering of the snapshot diff (twin of /diff).
All three State Lists for the project, ordered by item type then position.

post.description: Add a State to a list. Refused when the list already holds this value.

delete.description: Remove a State from its list. Refused while any item still holds it.

patch.description: Rename a State. Items reference it by id, so every one of them follows.

post.description: Set the display order of one list. The other two lists are untouched.
